title: Marie de Médicis (Brulart) to Savary de Brèves, Rome, 15 Sept and 10 Nov 1610 (BnF fr. 3789)

documents.shelfmark: BnF fr. 3789, stamped f. 19r (notice no. 12, 'fol. 21'); DECODE R2076

transcription.notes: Code letters with a trailing comma are counted as separate tokens from the bare letter.

documents.shelfmark: BnF fr. 3789, stamped f. 17r (notice no. 11); DECODE R2075

system.summary: Probably the Henri IV-Brèves 1610 cipher (key BnF fr. 3642, DECODE R2077): homophonic alphabet using Latin letters as signs, plain and overbarred numeric codes and comma-marked letter codes.
system.sibling_key: R2077 (Henri IV to Brèves, 5 Jan 1610), key photo on DECODE
system.notes: Attribution to the R2077 key rests on shared sign types and a DECODE note; not confirmed by a reading.

conditions.human_role: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie to the model, set up Claude Code, and posed the problem with /goal. No target-specific intervention recorded.
tools: beam.py (beam search over key-derived candidate letters, fr-1600-letters LM)

solution.what: Located no. 12 in the scan: notice folios run two ahead of the stamped foliation; letter is stamped f. 19 (canvas 36).
Transcribed the 10 Nov passage and the 15 Sept sibling from full-resolution canvases.
Applied values from the interlinear-deciphered Villeroy 1605 letter in the same volume (f. 26).
Tomokiyo louisxiii.htm and DECODE: R2077 broken by Lasry/Biermann/Tomokiyo 2021; key in BnF fr. 3642, photo on R2077.
Read the 833-px key photo: alphabet, t-z box, codes 4-99, comma letter codes, barred 4-46; M-Z codes missing.
Beam search over each sign's candidate letters from the key reading, scored with fr-1600-letters.
Found Brèves's reply of 9 Dec 1610 to the 10 Nov letter (Cinq cents de Colbert 351, pp. 724-730); it paraphrases the Savoy/Spain points, no quotation of the ciphered words.

outcome.method_basis: The probable key (Henri IV-Brèves 1610, BnF fr. 3642, photo on DECODE R2077) is only available as a partial 833-px photo, and a beam search with it gave no French; Brèves's 9 Dec 1610 reply paraphrases the passage without quoting it.
outcome.notes: Closed: key photo partial, reply of 9 Dec 1610 paraphrases only; 72 4 79 = [Conchine?] le pape avec is tentative. Reopen with Lasry's R2077 decryption or a BnF fr. 3642 image.
